name: What is the process for repainting house siding?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for repainting house siding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our siding repainting process typically begins with a thorough inspection and surface preparation. This involves power washing to remove dirt and mildew, scraping loose paint, sanding rough areas, and repairing any damaged siding. Next, we apply a high-quality primer if necessary, especially on bare wood or repaired sections. Finally, two coats of premium exterior paint are applied evenly, ensuring complete coverage and a durable finish. We protect surrounding landscaping and clean up thoroughly upon completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: The siding repainting process involves inspection, surface preparation (washing, scraping, repairs), priming, and applying two coats of quality exterior paint, followed by cleanup.
